text:
alex (PM): Need final cutline for Milestone 7 by EOD. TL;DR: keep embeddings cache, rate-limit per-tenant, and autoscale; defer admin telemetry UI, per-tenant tracing, and advanced quant configs to v1. Propose CSV export + a customer-facing "analytics API" pilot for top customers. Agree?
riley (eng): Agree with keeps. Tracing is a deep change (sampling, storage) and blocks infra. CSV + API pilot is a nice compromise.
tara (eng-ml): embeddings cache essential for 95p latency. Note: cache schema change needed to avoid churn on cold keys; that's one sprint. I'll post PR.
noah (design): If we defer telemetry UI, we should ship a lightweight placeholder with a pilot CTA and export flow so CS can demo. I can mock a placeholder today.
jess (sales): BetaCorp + DeltaLabs will push for telemetry. They'll accept pilot access if we commit to a migration path and a clear internal ETA (no public dates). I can secure their interest.
sam (prod-ops): Add feature_flag: limited-telemetry. I'll draft internal runbook and release blurb explaining data coverage. Also suggest a migration script for current users relying on admin telemetry.
riley (eng): Dev cutlist:
```
- ship (MVP): embeddings-cache, per-tenant rate-limit, autoscale pools
- add: csv-export endpoint, analytics-api pilot (limited), feature_flag limited-telemetry
- defer (v1): admin telemetry UI + long-term tracing store, advanced quant configs
```
alex (PM): Riley, can you post rough story points + blocker list by 11:30? Need to update milestone board before PM sync.
tara (eng-ml): I'll add a small eval: duplicate-token rate + latency regression check when cache is enabled. Will open PR today.
noah (design): Placeholder mock + export UX ready by 4pm. Will attach link.
jess (sales): I'll get BetaCorp and DeltaLabs into pilot queue; will ask for quick signoffs and offer migration help.
sam (prod-ops): Release blurb draft incoming; will include CS playbook and legal reqs for pilot.
release-bot: Milestone 7 deploy window: 3419999999. Update release checklist if shipping items change.
alex (PM): Recap & owners: Riley -> story points + blockers by 11:30; Tara -> eval PR today; Noah -> mocks by 4pm; Sam -> release blurb + runbook by EOD; Jess -> pilot signups. Thanks all :thumbsup:
